top_signals.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine has given U.S. negotiators proposals for ending the war with Russia
top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian president also said there is evidence that Russia would exploit next month's elections to proclaim a new mobilization to boost the numbers of fighting personnel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China Earnings to Test Rotation From AI to Internet Stocks
top_signals.summary: A rotation into China’s biggest tech firms from AI infrastructure stocks will be tested this week as earnings are due.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US judge cites ‘concerning’ irregularities in Adani fraud case
top_signals.summary: Nicholas Garaufis of Brooklyn federal court points to ‘repeat attempts to resolve this bribery case with monetary offers’
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
